name: ER-SDE
plain: Extended Reverse-Time SDE solver: first-order core with second and third stage corrections from history, using numerically integrated terms under a configurable noise scaler. The node can switch that scaler to reverse-time SDE or to plain ODE, and η controls it. One model call per step.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
ρ=σ/α=e^{−λ}, half-logSNR λ. ψ default ρ(e^{ρ^0.3}+10). r=ψ(ρ')/ψ(ρ), dt=ρ'−ρ, α'=σ'/ρ', α=σ/ρ.
Stage 1: x'=(α'/α)r·x+α'(1−r)D.
Stage 2 (i≥1): grid ρ_j=ρ'+j(−dt/200), S=Σ(1/ψ(ρ_j))(−dt/200); D₁=(D−D_old)/(ρ−ρ_{i−1}); x'+=α'(dt+Sψ(ρ'))D₁.
Stage 3 (i≥2): S_u=Σ((ρ_j−ρ)/ψ(ρ_j))(−dt/200); D₂=(D₁−D₁,old)/((ρ−ρ_{i−2})/2); x'+=α'(dt²/2+S_uψ(ρ'))D₂.
Noise: x'+=α'·n·s_noise·√(ρ'²−ρ²r²), NaN→0.
Node scalers: ER-SDE ψ=ρ(e^{ρ^0.3}+10)^η; reverse-time ψ=ρ^{η+1}; ODE ψ=ρ with s_noise=0.

props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Node exposes solver_type ER-SDE, Reverse-time SDE, ODE; max_stage 1 to 3; eta; s_noise. eta=0 forces the ODE path.

label: from code
surprise: Integrals are a 200-point left Riemann sum per step, run on the latent's device.
